DEMO GROUP HEALTH SHIELD - POLICY WORDING (Version 2)
DEFINITIONS AND ELIGIBILITY

Eligibility
Insured Person means the Employee of the Master Policyholder, the Employee's Spouse, the Employee's dependent children and the Employee's dependent Parents, in each case named in the Certificate.

Dependent Parents means the mother or father of the Employee who are named in the Certificate of Insurance or added by Endorsement.

Sum Insured Structure
Each Insured Person has an individual sum insured. A claim paid for one Insured Person does not reduce the sum insured of any other Insured Person. A corporate buffer of Rs. 25,00,000 is available to the whole group and is released only on approval of the Master Policyholder.

Addition of Insured Persons During the Policy Period
A newborn child of an Insured Employee may be added by Endorsement during the policy period. Cover for the added person starts from the effective date of the Endorsement.

Occupation
Cover under this Policy is available to Employees of the Master Policyholder engaged in software services and office-based duties. Injury arising from hazardous occupations such as underground mining, offshore rig work or armed forces duty is not payable.
